subject: Lighting inside and around cabinetry
hook: Bespoke kitchens with the lighting planned in.
gbp:
Planning a new kitchen in Congleton or elsewhere in Cheshire East and Staffordshire? SUPERIO designs and builds bespoke kitchens made to measure in our own workshop in Hanley — and we plan the lighting into the cabinets from the start.

Lighting under wall units, along plinths and inside tall larders is easy to get right at the design stage and awkward to add once units are fitted. We mark light positions on your kitchen drawings, agree cable routes through the cabinets and leave reachable spaces for drivers, so your electrician can connect everything without cutting into finished panels.

What's included: a free, no-obligation design consultation; a full measure and an itemised quote with transparent pricing; manufacture in our own workshop, quality-checked before it leaves; and delivery and installation by our own team. Finishes include matt, super matt, gloss, painted and wood-effect, with soft-close hardware as standard.

Book a free kitchen design consultation.
